title: Dimension-independent multipartite disentangling from bipartite unentangled inputs

standard_prerequisites.name: Standard quantum de Finetti, trace-distance inequalities, and cited nonnegative-proof NEXP characterization
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Exact imported statements and full author bibliography retained; all local PAPO, slicing and protocol proofs included.

core_obligations: Construct the PAPO channel and analyze its pure-almost-product output.
Prove dimension-independent slicing estimates and transfer them to the multipartite disentangler.
difficulty_reason: Constructs a pure-almost-product output procedure and proves a dimension-independent trace-distance bound using quantum slicing de Finetti estimates. The bipartite unentanglement input assumption and the complete local slicing proofs are retained; those supporting theorems are uncounted.

dedup.scope: Root checked complete legacy, aliases, preparation and both active production lines for this exclusively allocated DOI without neighbors. These records count the disentangler channel, almost-real sign-biased proof characterization, and critical three-proof gap amplification. PAPO, slicing, super-test and multiplexing supporting results remain uncounted.

locator_notes: Target author label thm:channel in intro.tex; complete author proof in the corresponding later section through original restatable macro. The official 28-page CCC text contains all seven retained sections and their complete proofs. No formal problem ID assigned.
